patterns: Single-fact identification dominates: who issued the Communal Award, who attended all three RTCs (Ambedkar), Poona Pact signed between Gandhi and Ambedkar.
Poona Pact traps: joint electorate with reserved seats (not separate); Gandhi did not personally sign; seats 71 vs 147/148.
'Not written by Ambedkar' book items (Servants of India, Gulamgiri) and Mooknayak = 'Leader of the Silent' recur; APPSC asked Osmania D.Litt 1953.
Gandhi's 1932 fast was against the Communal Award; Harijan upliftment followed the Poona Pact; Anti-Untouchability League -> Harijan Sevak Sangh.
App adds many multi-statement/match items on RTC dates and attendee lists, deeper than the PYQs' direct style.
